known_announcements.title: LINE WORKS Service Notice (2026.06.23) - Discontinued features and specification changes
known_announcements.summary: Service notice announcing discontinued features and specification changes scheduled for late July/August 2026. Includes admin-screen label renames (audit log column names). Assessed as UI/admin-level changes, not developer API changes.

known_announcements.title: 네이버웍스 코어 정기 업데이트 (2026-07-23)
known_announcements.summary: New developer APIs added: channel folder API, mail-moving API, task search API, document search API. Messenger type field changed: TWITTER value renamed to X. Message content download API gained channelId parameter. Tracked in GitHub issue #27 (closed).

known_announcements.title: 네이버웍스 코어 & 웍스 드라이브 일부 기능의 사양 변경 및 종료 안내
known_announcements.summary: Specification changes and discontinued features in NAVER Works Core and Works Drive as part of v4.3 regular update (July 2025). Includes board redirect URL change and low-usage feature adjustments. Assessed as service-level changes; API impact indirect.

known_announcements.title: LINE WORKS Developers — January 2026 update (delegated apps + Partner API)
known_announcements.summary: Developer Console updated January 22, 2026. Changes include delegated apps in Developer Console and new options-related operations in the Partner API.

known_announcements.title: TWITTER 값 지원종료 예정 — 멤버/연락처 API messenger 타입 필드 (2026-11~12월)
known_announcements.summary: The TWITTER value in the messenger type field of member and contact APIs will be removed. Korean docs target: mid-November 2026; Japanese docs target: early December 2026. The value was already renamed to X in the July 2026 core update; this notice tracks the final removal. Additionally, zipCode max length will change to 20 in early December 2026. Reported in GitHub issue #40.
